watch_keywords: 浙江温岭至福建霞浦 巴威
key_facts: July 10 MAJOR NORTHWARD SHIFT (NMC 10:00 & 18:00 CST Orange Warnings, Xinhua 21:08/23:21 CST, China Daily/Chao News, Reuters/Straits Times July 10): Typhoon Bavi tracked sharply NNW over the past 24h (18.7N 128.9E Jul 9 17:00 -> 20.4N 128.0E Jul 10 05:00 -> 22.2N 126.6E Jul 10 17:00, ~830 km SE of the Zhejiang-Fujian border, weakened to Typhoon 13-level / 40 m/s / 960 hPa, moving NW at 20-25 km/h). Critically: (1) NMC shifted the southern boundary ~130 km north from Fuqing, Fujian (25.7N) to Xiapu, Fujian (26.88N) at 10:00 CST and at 18:00 CST flipped the wording to Zhejiang Wenling (28.37N) to Fujian Xiapu (26.88N), delaying landfall to early Sunday morning July 12 CST (late July 11 UTC), followed by a NW-to-northerly turn; (2) ~70-76% of the Wenling-Xiapu coastal segment (~173 km Zhejiang vs ~54-83 km Fujian) lies north of the Shacheng Bay provincial border (27.16N), with midpoint ~55-65 km north of the border around Pingyang/Ruian/Wenzhou, Zhejiang; (3) Reuters July 10 explicitly switched centerline from Fujian to Wenzhou, Zhejiang, Chao News/China Daily reported forecasters see direct southern Zhejiang landfall increasingly likely, Zhejiang Met warned of direct hit, and Taiwan CWA/AP confirmed Bavi will pass NORTH of Taiwan (removing Taiwan mountain southward deflection). With ~32h lead time (sigma ~95-100 km) around mu ~+60-65 km north of border, swung Zhejiang 0.35->0.74, Fujian 0.62->0.24, Shanghai 0.01, Jiangsu 0.005, Shandong 0.005 (conditional on mainland China landfall, sum 1.00).
next_review_trigger: URGENT July 11-12 check for NMC final landfall announcement (expected early July 12 CST / late July 11 UTC) and lock 0.98-0.99 immediately once NMC reports landfall county.
